status: proposed engineering requirements for physical design, not demonstrated thermal performance
normal_electrical_envelope_status: All power allocations and required thermal paths must be established by the actual circuit/structure. They do not extend the earlier 11W capacitor/bridge model or bound fault power. No optical-efficiency credit is used in the 8W light-compartment heat budget. Gate heat can overlap conservatively between part allocations; this is a heat-removal budget, not a prediction of actual input power.
layout_inputs: No heat-producing component or high-voltage copper under the projected footprint of C4 on either PCB face, per Panasonic source; vent and case isolation retained.
Keep C1/C4 outside R1/Q1/T1/TVS1 direct radiative hot spots; geometry is to be verified, not assigned an invented millimetre spacing.
Thermal sensor placement must bound hottest capacitor/core/junction minus sensor temperature including transient lag; no unspecified board location may inherit these budgets.
Any copper heat-spreading from primary switching nodes must respect independently approved insulation/EMI limits; external metal heat spreaders cannot be connected directly to primary nodes.
